name: test-results-canvas
description: GitHub Copilot canvas extension that renders .NET TRX and JUnit XML test runs as a live UI panel.

scripts.test: node --import tsx --test test/labels.test.ts test/trx.test.ts test/junit.test.ts test/validate.test.ts test/rowkey.test.ts test/ask.test.ts test/coverage-parsers.test.ts test/coverage-patch.test.ts test/coverage-discover.test.ts test/coverage-derive.test.ts
scripts.test:ci: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('test-results',{recursive:true})" && node --import tsx --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=test-results/unit-junit.xml     test/labels.test.ts test/trx.test.ts test/junit.test.ts test/validate.test.ts test/rowkey.test.ts test/ask.test.ts test/coverage-parsers.test.ts test/coverage-patch.test.ts test/coverage-discover.test.ts test/coverage-derive.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('test-results',{recursive:true})" && node --import tsx --enable-source-maps --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=test-results/unit-junit.xml --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=test-results/lcov.info test/labels.test.ts test/trx.test.ts test/junit.test.ts test/validate.test.ts test/rowkey.test.ts test/ask.test.ts test/coverage-parsers.test.ts test/coverage-patch.test.ts test/coverage-discover.test.ts test/coverage-derive.test.ts
